summary: Parents are the ones most often pulled into school and youth groups, and working there ties them to other parents and staff.
realLife: The Bureau of Labor Statistics found about 31 percent of parents of children under 18 volunteered, versus about 23 percent of adults without children, and a quarter of volunteers served mainly with educational or youth groups.
sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Volunteering in the United States news release: https://www.bls.gov/news.release/volun.nr0.htm
inGame: school record of the child links a parent to the school; ties to other parents and staff change with shared work.
